title: Lots of pieces; takes a while to assemble; good assembly instructions
text: Lots of pieces; takes a while to assemble; good assembly instructions. Like a lot of furniture these days, this is made from press wood or chipboard or whatever you call it.  I had a pretty good idea that it would be when I ordered it.  Solid wood furniture is very expensive, so this is a good alternative for saving some money.  It looks to be decent quality and will look good once I finish assembly.  It is going together slowly because there are a LOT of pieces.  Set aside some time to assemble this, as you won't be able to put it together quickly.  The assembly instructions are easy to follow and seem complete, so it there is nothing difficult here; just a little time consuming.  I think it will be okay in the end, but sometimes because the screws holding it together are going into press wood, some of the wood can crack or chip out a little, but eventually seems like the screws will hold okay.  Appears to be a solid, attractive desk, easy to assemble and an affordable price.  I would not hesitate to recommend it, if you can't afford solid wood.
